title: CMake/unix-cache.cmake: document BSD version requirements for two features
body:
Cherry-picked from #23448

<!--
        IMPORTANT:
        If you cannot understand or explain your work without using
        Artificial Intelligence (AI) then do not file here. Do not paste
        massive AI generated explanations. We accept the use of AI as long as
        it is digestible. Please explain your issues or improvements briefly
        and clearly in your own human voice.
-->

files.patch:
@@ -64,7 +64,7 @@ if(APPLE OR
    CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "OpenBSD")
   set(HAVE_EVENTFD 0)
 elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux" OR
-       CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "FreeBSD" OR
+       CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "FreeBSD" OR  # 13.0+
        CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "MidnightBSD" OR
        CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "NetBSD")
   set(HAVE_EVENTFD 1)
@@ -235,7 +235,7 @@ if(APPLE OR
    CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "DragonFlyBSD")
   set(HAVE_SENDMMSG 0)
 else()
-  set(HAVE_SENDMMSG 1)
+  set(HAVE_SENDMMSG 1)  # OpenBSD 7.2+
 endif()
 set(HAVE_SENDMSG 1)
 set(HAVE_SETLOCALE 1)
@@ -274,7 +274,7 @@ if(APPLE OR
    CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "OpenBSD")
   set(HAVE_SYS_EVENTFD_H 0)
 elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux" OR
-       CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "FreeBSD" OR
+       CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "FreeBSD" OR  # 13.0+
        CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "MidnightBSD" OR
        CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "NetBSD")
   set(HAVE_SYS_EVENTFD_H 1)
